1. **Qh8+** (check) Ke7 (forced; if Bxh8, Black recaptures the queen)
2. **Qxd8+** (check, winning the queen) Kxd8

White is up the queen for nothing in a winning endgame.

**Main line:** Qh8+ Ke7 Qxd8+ Kxd8

**Coaching note:**
Your queen check on h8 was the winning blow. When the Black king moved to f8, it walked into a devastating back-rank fork. After Qh8+ forces Ke7, your Qxd8+ simply wins the queen with check—the king cannot defend it. Look for forcing checks when the opponent's king is exposed on the edge of the board. Checks + attacks on major pieces often reveal hidden combinations.
